decision.reason: [ev-f7d3abb12e99] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that metrics now "support gRPC and gRPC-Web protocol" and points to PR #9483 for the details. It does not say what concretely changed: for example, whether there is a new protocol label or value on existing request metrics, new metric series, or which metrics providers are affected. It also gives no applicability condition, such as metrics being enabled or gRPC traffic being routed. The two proposals read it differently: P2 thinks metrics endpoints now accept gRPC requests, while P1 thinks protocol support was added to the metrics themselves. That ambiguity shows we need the PR description or the metrics documentation before anyone can write the applicability aspect.
